fold: <N> has no wall, and nothing has yet come against it that a wall would have stopped.
text: Beishan has no wall, and nothing has yet come against it that a wall would have stopped.
why: says nothing has yet come against it; PAST records The Purge, a major occupation-infiltration 205 years ago

fold: Everyone entering <N> is counted at the gate by a soldier whose job it is, and counted again on the way out.
text: Everyone entering Khirbetziyarat is counted at the gate by a soldier whose job it is, and counted again on the way out.
why: 'Everyone entering is counted at the gate'; underground passage and smuggling move people and goods beneath the walls unseen

fold: Criminal work at <N> is coordinated enough to hold routes and territories and not coordinated enough to have a head; several interests are running, and none of them is the # to talk to.
text: Criminal work at Khanserai is coordinated enough to hold routes and territories and not coordinated enough to have a head; several interests are running, and none of them is the one to talk to.
why: crime has 'no head, none is the one to talk to'; Thieves' Guild is a listed power led by rank-1 Vandansüren Taichiud

fold: Nobody at <N> is paid to keep order, and for now the place keeps order well enough by itself.
text: Nobody at Polask is paid to keep order, and for now the place keeps order well enough by itself.
why: says the place keeps order well enough; Foundations prints Law & order Critical and the defence rows say nothing keeps order

fold: <N>'s pay book is always behind: its defenders are paid late or not at all, and people owed wages are slow to turn out when trouble comes.
text: Sübeteigol's pay book is always behind: its defenders are paid late or not at all, and people owed wages are slow to turn out when trouble comes.
why: defenders paid late or not at all, a pay book; DEFENCE has hired none, garrison none, watch none: only unpaid citizen militia

fold: <N>'s defences are sound, and the only people who would stand on them are the village's own.
text: Sübeteigol's defences are sound, and the only people who would stand on them are the village's own.
why: calls the defences sound; STATE defence is Vulnerable and the same page says they could not survive a serious attack and are underfunded

fold: The guards' rations at <N> are cut like everyone else's, and a hungry guard cannot be asked for much for long.
text: The guards' rations at Sübeteigol are cut like everyone else's, and a hungry guard cannot be asked for much for long.
why: speaks of the guards' rations; DEFENCE has garrison none, watch none, hired none: only a citizen militia

fold: Nobody at <N> is in a position to take the Household Council's place: whatever the hamlet thinks of the Household Council, no contender stands ready to try.
text: Nobody at Polask is in a position to take the Household Council's place: whatever the hamlet thinks of the Household Council, no contender stands ready to try.
why: says no contender stands ready; TENSIONS has a live succession crisis with a Popular candidate and rivals maneuvering to take the seat

fold: The thorp's record of crimes at <N> stays short: there is crime, but enforcement keeps it down and keeps it from growing.
text: The thorp's record of crimes at Beishan stays short: there is crime, but enforcement keeps it down and keeps it from growing.
why: says enforcement keeps crime down; DEFENCE has no watch, garrison or force and neighbours deal with wrongs themselves
